evidence.reason: Disabled inherited gitattributes for the oracle's throwaway repos by pinning core.attributesFile to os.devnull via the highest-precedence -c override in GIT_CONFIG and setting GIT_ATTR_NOSYSTEM=1 in both scrubbed git environments, so a host global *.ts text attribute can no longer normalize the crlf-astral CRLF blob on git add; no fixture regeneration is needed since production reads only touch immutable objects.
